scripts.build: npm --workspace frontend run build && npm --workspace backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --workspace backend run lint:fix && npm --workspace frontend run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --workspace backend run format && npm --workspace frontend run format
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: npm --workspace backend run test:coverage && npm --workspace frontend run test:coverage
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
